email.label: Email
email.description: Send and receive emails via the built-in MTA.

sms.label: SMS
sms.description: Send text messages via Twilio or compatible providers.

whatsapp.label: WhatsApp
whatsapp.description: Send messages via the WhatsApp Business API.

generic.label: Generic webhook
generic.description: Receive inbound messages from any HTTP endpoint via a shared secret.

chat.label: Chat
chat.description: Native in-app chat powered by the built-in messaging system.

channelConfigForm.displayNameHint: Optional. Shown in the UI instead of the default channel name.
channelConfigForm.credentialsNotice: Saved credentials are encrypted and not shown again. Leave a field blank to keep its stored value; type in one to replace just that credential.

info.email: Email is built in — there are no credentials to set here. Configure email sending under Sending Domains and your delivery provider in Technical settings.
info.chat: Chat is natively integrated and requires no additional configuration.

authToken.label: Auth Token
authToken.hint: Used to send, and to verify the signature on inbound Twilio webhooks.

businessAccountId.label: Business Account ID
businessAccountId.placeholder: Enter your WhatsApp Business Account ID
businessAccountId.hint: Recorded for reference. Outbound sends are keyed on the Phone Number ID below.

appSecret.label: App Secret
appSecret.hint: Inbound only. Verifies the X-Hub-Signature-256 on messages Meta posts to /webhooks/whatsapp.

verifyToken.label: Verify Token
verifyToken.placeholder: Any string you also paste into Meta
verifyToken.hint: Inbound only. Answers Meta's subscription challenge when you point it at /webhooks/whatsapp.

endpointUrl.label: Endpoint URL
endpointUrl.hint: Outbound POSTs are unsigned — put any authentication in the URL itself (secret path or query token).

secretKey.label: Secret Key
secretKey.hint: Inbound only. Callers to /webhooks/channel must echo it in X-Webhook-Secret or Authorization: Bearer.

chatInput.placeholder: Type a message… use {'@'} to mention
chatInput.hint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for newline · {'@'} to mention · paste or attach files

removeDialog.title: Remove member?
removeDialog.description: Remove {name} from the channel? They will lose access to it.
